description: Map of option key to user-configurable value definition (see userConfigOption).

propertyNames.description: Option key: a valid identifier (letters, digits, underscore; no leading digit). It becomes CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY> in hook processes.

userConfigOption.description: One user-configurable value. Claude Code prompts for it when the plugin is enabled and exposes it as ${user_config.KEY} and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY>. Unknown keys are rejected.

type.description: Value type: string, number, boolean, directory or file.

title.description: Label shown in the configuration dialog.

description.description: Help text shown beneath the field.

sensitive.description: If true, input is masked and the value is stored in secure storage (macOS Keychain or ~/.claude/.credentials.json) instead of settings.json. Cannot be combined with options.

required.description: If true, validation fails when the field is empty.

default.description: Value used when the user provides nothing. With options it must be one of the options (the schema cannot cross-check that).

items.description: One accepted value, 1-64 characters, no leading/trailing space, no control/invisible/bidi characters.

options.description: For type string: the only values the field accepts, shown in /config as a picker. Requires Claude Code v2.1.271 or later (older versions cannot load a plugin that declares options). Rules: type must be string; multiple and sensitive must not be true; default must be one of the options, or required must be true when default is unset; options must not repeat even in a different letter case.

multiple.description: For type string: allow an array of strings. Cannot be combined with options.

type.description: A field with options must have type string.

multiple.description: A field with options must not set multiple to true.

sensitive.description: A field with options must not set sensitive to true.

required.description: Without a default, a field with options must set required to true.
